hypotheses.reasoning: Starting at 11:07, template-svc's S3 PutObject calls in us-east-1 return 503 ServiceUnavailable (#92, #96, #101). The AWS SDK then runs out of retries (#98). Because the storage write fails, template-svc returns 500 to notification-svc (#89, #117), and the gateway sends back 500s on POST /v1/notify. Traffic and latency were normal right before the failures began, so our own load does not explain them. The gateway disk-usage warning (#30) is unrelated.
The S3 503 messages ask clients to reduce their request rate. If SDK retries made the throttling worse, this could be partly self-inflicted.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check AWS S3 us-east-1 status. Make template-svc's artifact writes tolerate failure: either accept the request and write asynchronously, or fall back to another bucket or region. Use backoff with jitter on retries.
